description: This file defines a React component named ChatbotWidget that renders a floating chat assistant interface for user interaction related to recipes, ingredients, substitutions, and cooking tips. The component manages conversation state, handles user input, communicates with a backend API to send and receive chat messages, and provides UI controls for opening, closing, and clearing the chat window.

methods.name: ChatbotWidget()
methods.description: React functional component rendering a floating recipe assistant chat widget.
